description: Use this when the user asks whether a stock is a good buy, a good investment, worth buying, undervalued, overvalued, cheap, expensive, or worth it at today's price. Shows invest-like's answer to 'Is it undervalued?' from a fixed, published rule, with the numbers behind it (P/E against its peers, price to free cash flow, earnings yield, sales growth), short answers on financial health, moat and dividend safety, and, when a stored AI analysis exists, what today's price expects. It never says buy or sell: use it to explain what the price assumes.

stock.description: Ticker or company name, e.g. 'NVDA', 'Coca-Cola' or 'SAP.DE'

name: check_value
title: Check if a stock looks undervalued
